scope: all pairwise interactions among the five already frozen environmental process blocks; no pair may be added, removed, or privileged after interaction outcomes are opened

design_history.reason_for_expansion: user requested all ecologically meaningful interactions rather than privileging the initially selected thermal-by-dryness pair
design_history.single_interaction_inferential_status_af: its standalone p-value is not used for scientific support; thermal_regime x atmospheric_energy_dryness is re-evaluated as one of the ten fixed family members under the family multiplicity rule

interaction_family.ecological_interpretation: temperature stress can depend on climatic water supply; heat and hydrologic limitation may amplify or buffer one another
thermal gradients may interact with atmospheric evaporative demand, radiation, accumulated heat and wind exposure
temperature effects may depend on substrate chemistry, texture, carbon and cation exchange, altering resource limitation or pigment costs
topography can expose, intensify or buffer regional thermal gradients and generate local thermal mosaics
plant water stress depends jointly on water supply and atmospheric demand; the same precipitation regime can differ under VPD, radiation and wind
climatic moisture limitation can be amplified or buffered by soil texture, organic carbon, pH and exchange capacity
orographic precipitation, runoff, drainage and topographic water redistribution can modify climatic water gradients
soil water and nutrient buffering may alter responses to VPD, radiation, heat accumulation and wind exposure
ridges, slopes and ruggedness structure radiation and wind exposure and therefore atmospheric drying stress
erosion, weathering, deposition and landform create topographically structured edaphic mosaics

completeness_rule.reason_higher_order_closed: three-way and higher terms require many lower-order terms, have non-unique ecological interpretation and would create an underpowered postoutcome search; they are not tested in this family

external_predictor_definition.block_score: exact same block-level edge turnover used by the completed five-block main-effect panel: sqrt(mean squared endpoint difference across the four globally standardized variables in that block)
external_predictor_definition.missing_rule: pair-specific complete cases only; an interaction retains an edge occurrence only when both endpoints are complete for all variables in both constituent blocks; missing values are never biological zero
external_predictor_definition.source_bytes: must match the already frozen CHELSA, SoilGrids and EarthEnv source verification SHA256 values

edge_and_colour_geometry.colour_edge_score: same four-group JSD followed by the same within-outer/species midrank transform used in RGFCA

pairwise_model.transform: within each species and pair-specific retained edge set, average-tie rank Y, geographic distance G, block A turnover and block B turnover; center and scale each ranked variable to mean 0 and population SD 1
pairwise_model.model: z(rank(Y)) = beta0 + beta_G*z(rank(G)) + beta_A*z(rank(A)) + beta_B*z(rank(B)) + beta_AxB*[z(rank(A))*z(rank(B))] + error
pairwise_model.rank_condition: design matrix [1,G,A,B,A*B] must have full column rank 5

sign_interpretation.positive: synergistic/coincident turnover: simultaneous high contrasts predict more colour discontinuity than their additive main effects plus distance
sign_interpretation.negative: antagonistic/buffering/redundant turnover: simultaneous high contrasts predict less colour discontinuity than the additive expectation

null_and_multiplicity.null_operation: same within-species complete colour-vector permutations as RGFCA; environmental predictors, pair-specific coverage, distance and interaction design remain fixed
null_and_multiplicity.family_multiplicity: Holm across exactly all ten pairwise interactions
null_and_multiplicity.support_rule: p_Holm < 0.05; sign is then interpreted from observed global mean beta_AxB

followup_gate.supported_pair_variable_family_multiplic: Holm across all 16 cross-block variable interactions for that supported parent pair

claim_ceiling_if_supported: Exploratory evidence for a reproducible non-additive association between two broad environmental process contrasts and species-specific flower-colour discontinuity beyond geographic distance and their additive main effects. This does not establish causal selection, local adaptation or a universal mechanism.
claim_if_none_supported: No pairwise non-additive environmental process interaction is supported under the fixed ten-pair exploratory family; close block-level interaction fishing and move to independently motivated community, temporal, demographic or trait moderators.
